_note: Trophy Room achievements (Technical Design Doc 2.1 lexicon.achievements). Supported condition types: stat_at_least (stat is a key of player_profile or statistics), run_completed_faster_than (seconds; checked against the run just finished), tree_fully_purchased (any one tree), player_level. reward_ink is paid once, the moment the achievement is earned.

achievements.name: First Steps
achievements.description: Finish your first run, win or lose.

achievements.name: Speed Demon
achievements.description: Clear a dungeon in under three minutes.

achievements.name: Vocabulary Master
achievements.description: Purchase every node in a single Vocabulary Tree.
